generativeModule: <0><0>Generative Module</0><1>Welcome to the Generative section! This is where you interact with generative AI models through conversational interfaces.</1><2>You can create sessions, chat with different generative models, and adjust their parameters in real-time to customize responses</2></0>
taskGallery: <0><0>Task Gallery</0><1>Here you can select the type of generative task you want to perform.</1><2>Choose from different model capabilities, such as text or image generation.</2><3>Each task includes a brief description to help you choose the most suitable one.</3></0>
taskCard: <0><0>Creating a Session</0><1>When you click on a task card, you'll start creating a <5>session</5>.</1><2>A <5>session</5> is a workspace where you interact with a generative model for a specific purpose.</2><3>Each session has its own chat history, parameters, and configuration.</3><4>Click on the <5>Text to Text</5> card to continue.</4></0>
selectModel: <0><0>Select a Model Family</0><1>Here you can choose from different <5>model families</5>.</1><2>A model family groups models with similar architecture and capabilities. For example, <5>Qwen</5> is a family of language models with different sizes and specializations.</2><3>After selecting a family, you'll be able to choose a specific model variant that best fits your needs.</3><4>Select the <5>Qwen</5> model to continue.</4></0>
modelParameters: <0><0>Model Selection and Parameter Configuration</0><1>Here you can choose a <5>specific model variant</5> and configure specific parameters.</1><2>Each model has different parameters that control how it generates responses. Common parameters include <5>temperature</5> (creativity level), <5>max_tokens</5> (response length), and model-specific settings.</2><3>You can adjust these parameters now or modify them later during your session.</3><4>This configuration will be saved with your session and can be changed at any time.</4></0>
createSession: <0><0>Create Session</0><1>Click <2>Create Session</2> to start chatting with the model.</1></0>
sessionsPanel: <0><0>Sessions Panel</0><1>Here you'll find all your sessions organized by task.</1><2>Your newly created session appears here and you can return to it anytime.</2></0>
parametersPanel: <0><0>Parameters Panel</0><1>Here you can modify the model parameters at any time during your session.</1><2>Try changing <5>Temperature</5> to adjust the creativity level of the responses.</2><3>Click <5>Update</5> to apply your changes.</3></0>
sendMessage: <0><0>Final Step! 🎉</0><1>Type a message in the text box and click <5>Send</5> to start the conversation.</1></0>
